# BetaPass by betarouter

> BetaPass is a flat-price subscription for AI coding tools. One API key unlocks 200+ models across 40+ providers in Claude Code, OpenCode, Cursor, Continue, and other OpenAI-compatible tools, with a fixed monthly usage allowance instead of surprise token bills.

## Plans

- Lite: $29/month — includes $87 of model usage at standard provider rates.
- Pro: $79/month — includes $237 of model usage.
- Max: $179/month — includes $537 of model usage.
- Every plan includes the newest frontier models as they are released and full cost tracking.

## Key pages

- [BetaPass](https://betapass.betarouter.com): Plans, supported coding agents, and setup.
- [Docs & integration guides](https://docs.betarouter.com/guides): Step-by-step setup for supported tools.
- [Models](https://betarouter.com/models): Full catalog of supported models with pricing and capabilities.
- [betarouter](https://betarouter.com): The hosted gateway platform BetaPass runs on.
- [Pricing (machine-readable)](https://betarouter.com/pricing.md): Plain-markdown pricing for the whole platform.

## Notes

- BetaPass works with any tool that speaks the OpenAI API format — point it at the gateway base URL.
- Usage allowances are metered at provider list rates; there is no markup on tokens.
